## Install or update (Claude Desktop)

Download **`spielebox.mcpb`** below and double-click it. If an older version is installed, Claude Desktop offers to update it;
your settings are kept.

Unofficial project, not affiliated with WIENXTRA. See the [README](https://github.com/janpaepke/spielebox-mcp#readme).

<details>
<summary>Verify the download</summary>

The file was built by this repository's release workflow. Check with the [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com):

```sh
gh attestation verify spielebox.mcpb --repo janpaepke/spielebox-mcp
```

</details>
